intervals.label: collaboration
intervals.note: Start is the year the pair experiment began (the CF group had worked on the earlier E70 phases since 1970). End is the last documented data-taking, September 1977; the true end of E288 running is not given.
intervals.quote: the originally proposed pair experiment got underway in 1975

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: Latest date by which a source shows data still being taken; not an end-of-run date.
intervals.quote: By September, with 30,000 events, the enhancement was resolved into three clearly separated peaks

name: E288 Collaboration (Columbia-Fermilab-Stony Brook)
notes: Formation date not published in the sources consulted. Lederman is named spokesman by the Fermilab history pages, but no person record is created here.

summary.plain: The Columbia, Fermilab and Stony Brook physicists, led by Leon Lederman, who ran experiment E288 at Fermilab and found the upsilon in 1977.
summary.technical: E288 Columbia-Fermilab-Stony Brook (CFS) collaboration; Lederman spokesman, Yoh experiment coordinator 1975-77; Stony Brook joined in 1976 for the di-hadron phases and the MuMu2 phase.
